messages:
Tara: tiny share 90ca meet Gus the hermit crab, who just upgraded his shell to what I can only describe as 'mid-century modern' 60a posted: gus_new_shell.jpg
Ben: that shell has better aesthetics than my apartment :joy: is it a literal Airbnb upgrade?
Lina: omg gus is living his best life. does he accept rent in snacks? :crab:
Tara: convinced he does. bribed him with a piece of shrimp and he struck this pose. short video incoming. uploaded: gus_strut.mp4
Miles: the strut clip is peak content. background music idea: tiny triumphant brass. honestly I'm emotional.
Jo: caption contest: "Gus: re-housed, recharged, ready for retros" :tada:
Ben: alternate caption: "When the shell fits, ship it" :shipitparrot: (ok that emoji is fake but you get it)
Lina: ops-bot, hypotheticals  could we ever do an office "bring your pet" for tiny critters? Gus is small and in a carrier.
ops-bot: Reminder: Pet visits require People Ops approval. For non-mammals/shellfish/critters, please request prior sign-off and transport in secure carriers. Include allergy check and details of containment.
Tara: thanks @ops-bot. will file the form if People Ops wants to meet tiny interior designers.
Miles: low-stakes poll: Gus office cameo (1) virtual cameo only (2) lobby hello in carrier (3) desk cameo with mat (react 1/2/3)
Jo: 1 for me; my desk is already a disaster zone :sweat_smile:
Ben: 2 if we promise no shell-envy drama.
Lina: 3! Gus deserves a staged photoshoot with tiny props. also anyone got shell-cleaning tips?
Tara: short note from the vet: gentle freshwater rinse, pebble substrate, and no citrus. will post care notes when I submit to People Ops. thanks for the love for Gus 60a
